summary: Vesta Real Estate Corporation, S.A.B. de C.V. filed a Form 6-K to report a restatement of its bylaws, approved by public deed and registered with the Mexican Public Registry of Commerce. The filing includes a certification from the board secretary and a draft translation of the restated bylaws. No size, price, premium, dates, or deal mechanics are disclosed. The amendment is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation. What to watch: none.
